caption: Comparison with other autonomous vehicle datasets. (a) represents the normalized density graph of the distance between the robot (or ego-vehicle) and surrounding pedestrians, while (b) illustrates the number of instances that satisfy some criteria. Space sharing condition refers to instances where the robot and pedestrians occupy the same semantic space, Proximity condition indicates cases where the distance between the robot and pedestrian is within 2 meters, and Sharing & Proxi. indicates cases that fulfill both conditions.
